Each course has its own page with links to every lecture. The lectures are
[reveal.js](https://revealjs.com) slide decks: press **F** for full screen,
**S** for speaker notes, **O** for an overview of all slides, and **Esc** to
leave either view.

::: {#courses}
:::

## Adding a course

Make a folder `courses/<course-name>/` with an `index.qmd` (copy an existing
one) and a `lectures/` folder for the decks. It appears in the list above on
the next render.
